channel.title: arthuryau's blog RSS
channel.description: Notes on agentic systems, ML infrastructure, and tooling.

item.title: agent-07 · Loop engineering is the harness on a timer
item.description: Loop engineering is harness engineering on a timer: schedule, state, spawn, and hard oracles. The hard part is choosing signals the loop cannot game.
item.dc:creator: Arthur Yau

item.title: agent-06 · Self-improving AI is a spectrum, not a switch
item.description: A spectrum map for self-improving AI: pseudo-labels, rewards, AI judges, generated tasks, harness improvement, and why we are still near the Rubicon.
item.dc:creator: Arthur Yau

item.title: agent-05 · Self-correction has three layers: decoding, workflow, and reasoning
item.description: A practical map of AI self-correction: decoding tricks, workflow feedback, and trained reasoning all need real signals, not just reflection.
item.dc:creator: Arthur Yau

item.title: agent-04 · Harness engineering is how we actually make agents useful
item.description: Harness engineering for agent builders: tools, permissions, workflows, feedback, memory, and verification loops that make an LLM usable.
item.dc:creator: Arthur Yau

item.title: agent-03 · What AI agents change about research work
item.description: A practical map of how AI agents change research work: cheaper first passes, more verification pressure, and human judgment moving to problem choice and evidence.
item.dc:creator: Arthur Yau

item.title: agent-02 · Multi-agent systems are topology problems
item.description: A builder-focused map of multi-agent systems as network topologies: when agents should branch, critique, compete, merge, or stay independent.
item.dc:creator: Arthur Yau

item.title: agent-01 · Context engineering is the agent's working memory
item.description: A practical taxonomy for agent context: prompt-visible workspace, external memory, compression, bounded observations, sub-agents, and on-demand skills.
item.dc:creator: Arthur Yau

item.title: agent-00 · The AI agent is a computer system around an LLM processor
item.description: A computer-architecture map for AI agents: LLM as processor, context as working set, memory as storage, tools as I/O, feedback as diagnostics, and harness as OS.
item.dc:creator: Arthur Yau

item.title: My setup for running 10+ CLI coding agents at once
item.description: How I orchestrate ~10 parallel CLI coding agents with tmux, Tailscale, Termius on iOS, and a small PWA panel for mobile control.
item.dc:creator: Arthur Yau
